title: Page 4
content_zh:
胡里揉手陪笑。“小的是觉得，不看曾面看佛面，大人好歹看在皇上，还有老爷的分上……”
于季友总算听了劝，觉得胡里说得也对，不管私底下他多讨厌这门亲事，既然他已允诺要娶，就该负责到底。
“我知道了。”说完，于季友调转马头，迳自往队伍后边骑去。
当天晚上，大队驻扎在翠华山麓，普宁的彩轿就停在队伍正中，四角皆以红布掩绕，成了一个回字。
一待安排好守夜的人手，于季友便拎着一只布袋来到回字中央。
一见他来，女官们正要问安，他却做了个噤声的动作。
“公主呢？”他放低音量问。
“在彩轿上睡着了。”一女官小声答：“要不要小的唤醒公主？”
“不用，我有其他事要你们去办。”于季友头朝外一点。“我刚才要厨子帮我做了点东西，你们去看看，好了就帮我端来。”
女官们不敢怠慢，几人福身，依序退下。
缀满珠花的彩轿周围，只剩下于季友，还有伏在上头熟睡的红影。
他放轻脚步走到普宁身边，本意只是想把东西留下，可一看见枕上娇颜，他脚步倏停。他从没想过，向来倍受宠爱的公主，也会有这种表情。
一直以来她给他的印象，尽是娇蛮霸道不讲理，可她睡着模样，却显得忧愁脆弱。他想，难不成身份高贵的娇娇公主，也有旁人难以理解的寂寞？
直到这时，他才想起两人年纪，足足差了七岁，一个十七、八岁姑娘，不管她身份多高贵，说到底，仍旧是个孩子。
是他太过苛刻，不该奢想她现在就能有他这般的冷静自制。
也难怪胡里动不动帮她说话，回想过去两天的行径，于季友叹气。动不动与她斗气的他，也不怎么厚道。
“这东西，就当作是赔礼吧。”他低头
这花，是他早先去摘的。
行前，普宁在宫里的随行护卫李进曾经暗访于季友，当夜便同他提起许多普宁不为人知的喜好。因为李进说了很多又说得很细，尽管于季友没仔细听，仍旧牢记了不少。
他说普宁喜欢槐花，还特别爱吃一般小馆常见的槐花麦饭，这是一道用槐花瓣与面粉同蒸的咸点。每年春季槐花盛放，她总会央求李进到宫外，帮她偷点点回来。

槐花麦饭制法不难，加上李进硬塞给他的亨制方法，队上厨子一读就懂。于季友怎样也没想到，早先懒得丢掉的册子，竟会有派上用场的时候。
随着布袋渐轻，轻柔若羽的槐花洒满彩轿里外，微风一吹，一阵清雅幽香四散，徐徐唤了枕上佳人。
这香气……好熟悉？！
普宁似醒未醒地张眼，几朵槐花自高处飘落。
“怎么会有这么多花……”她作梦似地伸手，再一瞧自个儿周围全布满香花，唇边立刻综出惊喜的笑靥。
她开心地起身，转头，便见于季友自布袋里掏出最后一把槐花，杨臂四洒。
“怎么是你？”不过眨眼，她一扫方才天具烂漫神情，又变回浑身利刺的娇蛮公主。“你来这里干嘛，你不是说成亲之前，我们都不能见面？”
“我听说你好几顿没吃。”他将掏空的布袋扔下，暗暗提醒自己，别再跟她一般见识。
“你不是很讨厌跟我成亲？我饿死了不正好稳你心意？”她抿嘴，眼里满是脆弱。
“下官不希望公主伤了身体。”
“我要怎么对待我自己是我的事，你又不在乎，少在那假惺惺。”
又来了。于季友叹气，她动不动就剑拔弩张，实在很难不动气。
“既然下怎么说说公主都不满意……”他一耸肩，一转身作势要走。
一见他转身，普宁连忙跳下彩轿。“等等，你还没告诉我你来做什么……哎呦！”
一声惊呼响起，于季友回头，只见她滑坐在地。
她急着留人，竟忘了自己胃囊空空，一激动，便觉得头晕目眩。
于季友赶忙来搀。“有没有摔着哪里？”
“膝盖……”
他一听，立刻将她扶上彩轿，翻高她裙摆检查，只见她洞圆温润的膝上，印着一个斗大的红印。
“会疼么？”他轻轻揉捏她膝盖。

“痛……”
“这样喔？”他试着动动她小腿，就怕她跌伤了筋骨。
没刚才痛－－她正想回答，可一望见他溢于言表的担忧，她突然忘了自己想说什么，瞧他的模样，似乎是真的关心她……
等不到回答，他抬头再问一次：“怎么样？痛不痛？”
“……不压就不痛。”一对上他探询的眼，她心头一慌，脸突然红了。
他松口气。“看样子只是摔红了膝盖，多休息两天就没事了。”
看他轻手轻脚的模样，那股子呵护，让她忍不住又问：“你还没回答我，你为什么要来，还帮我摘了那么多花？”
“下官刚才说过了，不想见公主伤了身子。”他顿了一下又说：“下官要厨子做了公主最喜欢的‘槐花麦饭’，刚叫女官们去端，应该快到了。”
她心头一甜，不过一想，不对啊，他打哪知道她喜欢吃槐花麦饭？“是谁告诉你的？”
他表情无奈。“您的问题还真多……”话刚说一半，便听见一阵脚步声。
“于大人，小的把东西端来了。”
“您先吃吧。”他睨她一眼，而后朗声喊：“端进来，公主已经醒了。”
见他说完又要走，她忙问道：“你要去哪？”
他叹气。“依礼，公主跟下官在拜堂之前，不能私下见面。”
又来了。普宁小嘴一嘟。
瞧她忽喜忽嗔的表情，他突然觉得可爱。直到现在他才发现，原来这个娇蛮公主，没他之前想的难相处。
“不要用那种眼神看我！”她斥道，可失落的神态，却泄漏了她的心情。
不顾她抗议，于季友将手伸到她面前，摸猫似的抚着她脸颊。
“讨厌，谁准你碰我……”
这一回，他可没被她表情吓跑。

“我会尽量找时间来看你。”手刚收回，女官们正好走进红布帷幛中。
“公主、于大人。”
于季友颔首。“你们伺候公主用膳，我先走了。”
“嗳……”不等普宁说完，于季友已经消失在帷幛外。“跑那么急干嘛，多陪我一下又不会死……”她嘟嚷着抱怨，不过一瞄见四散的槐花瓣，她又立刻综了抹笑。
就说吧，怎么可能有人不喜欢她……
她掬起如羽的花瓣朝空一丢，片片香花散落，如雪般覆在她头上身上。
她此刻心情，就像纷飞的花瓣一样，轻盈雀跃。
而后她望向女官们，甜甜一笑。“拿来啊，不是要叫我叫东西？”
她这么一说，女官们笑逐颜开地将吃食送上。
第2章(2)
又是一日，大队仍在前往襄州的路上；一早，于季友便叫胡里过来问安。
“我们家大人今早观了云，他觉得明儿个或许会下雨，今天中午可能不停队休息，看能不能趁晚赶进下一个城镇。”
在彩轿里边织绣打发时间的普宁抬头问道：“你们家大人就交代了这些，没别的了？”
“回禀公主，当然还有。”萌里从鞍上解下一个包袱。“这是我们家大人一早发现的，他说公主您应该会喜欢。”
一名女官接来
是一颗颗红艳如霞，大若儿拳的甜杏。
她掀帘问道：“真是他特别为我摘的？”
胡里靳钉截铁地回道：“回禀公主，千真万确，小的岂敢胡诌。”
content_en:
Hu Li rubbed his hands and laughed. "The younger one thinks that if you don't look at Zeng's face and look at the Buddha's face, it's for the sake of the emperor and the master..."
Yu Jiyou finally listened to the advice and felt that Hu Li was right. No matter how much he hated this marriage privately, since he had promised to marry, he should be responsible to the end.
"I understand." After saying that, Yu Jiyou turned his horse's head and rode directly behind the team.
That night, the brigade was stationed at the foot of Cuihua Mountain. Puning's colorful sedan was parked in the middle of the group, with its four corners covered with red cloth, forming the character "Hui".
As soon as the manpower for the night watch was arranged, Yu Jiyou came to the center of the word Hui carrying a cloth bag.
When they saw him coming, the female officials were about to say hello, but he made a gesture of silence.
"Where's the princess?" he asked in a lower voice.
"I fell asleep on the sedan chair." A female official whispered, "Would you like me to wake up the princess?"
"No, I have other things for you to do." Yu Jiyou pointed his head outward. "I just asked the chef to make something for me. You guys go and take a look and bring it to me when it's ready."
The female officials did not dare to neglect, and several of them retired in order.
Around the colorful sedan decorated with beads and flowers, only Yu Jiyou and the sleeping red figure were lying on top.
He walked lightly to Puning's side. His original intention was just to leave the things behind, but when he saw the beautiful face on the pillow, his steps stopped suddenly. He never thought that the princess who had always been favored would have such an expression.
The impression she had given him all along was that she was coquettish, domineering and unreasonable, but when she was sleeping, she looked sad and fragile. He thought, is it possible that the noble Princess Jiaojiao also has a loneliness that is difficult for others to understand?
It was only then that he remembered that there was a full seven years difference in age between the two of them. A girl of seventeen or eighteen years old, no matter how noble her status, was still a child in the final analysis.
He was too harsh, and he shouldn't expect that she could be as calm and self-controlled as him now.
No wonder Hu Li always spoke for her. Thinking back on his actions in the past two days, Yu Jiyou sighed. He was always quarrelsome with her, and he wasn't very kind either.
"Just think of this as an apology." He lowered his head.
This flower was picked by him earlier.
Before leaving, Li Jin, Puning's escort in the palace, paid a secret visit to Yu Jiyou and told him many of Puning's unknown hobbies that night. Because Li Jin talked a lot and was very detailed, even though Yu Jiyou didn't listen carefully, he still remembered a lot.
He said that Puning liked Sophora japonica flowers and especially liked to eat Sophora japonica wheat rice, which is common in restaurants. This is a salty snack steamed with Sophora japonica petals and flour. Every spring when the locust trees were in full bloom, she would always beg Li Jin to go outside the palace and steal some for her.
The method of making sophora flower wheat rice is not difficult, and the cook on the team can understand it immediately after Li Jin forced him to make it. Yu Jiyou never expected that the book he was too lazy to throw away earlier would come in handy.
As the bag becomes lighter, the soft and feathery locust flowers fill the inside and outside of the colorful sedan. When the breeze blows, a burst of elegant fragrance spreads, slowly calling the beautiful lady on the pillow.
This scent... seems so familiar? !
Puning opened his eyes as if awake, and saw a few locust flowers falling from a high place.
"How come there are so many flowers..." She stretched out her hand as if dreaming, and when she saw that there were fragrant flowers all around her, a surprise smile appeared on her lips.
She stood up happily, turned around, and saw Ji You taking out the last handful of Sophora japonica flowers from the cloth bag, spreading them in all directions.
"Why is it you?" But in the blink of an eye, she swept away the rosy expression of the genius just now, and turned back into the delicate and savage princess with sharp thorns all over her body. "What are you doing here? Didn't you say that we can't see each other before we get married?"
"I heard that you haven't eaten for several meals." He threw down the empty bag and secretly reminded himself not to be like her again.
"Don't you hate getting married to me? Why don't I starve to death to keep you in mind?" She pursed her lips, her eyes full of vulnerability.
"I don't want the princess to get hurt."
"How I treat myself is my business, and you don't care, so don't worry about it.hypocritically. "
Here we go again. Yu Jiyou sighed. She was always on the verge of getting angry. It was really hard for her to remain angry.
"Since the princess is not satisfied no matter what I say..." He shrugged and turned around to leave.
As soon as he turned around, Puning jumped off the sedan chair. “Wait a minute, you haven’t told me what you’re here for yet… Oops! "
There was an exclamation, and Yu Jiyou turned around, only to see her sliding to the ground.
She was so anxious to keep people that she forgot that her stomach was empty, and she felt dizzy when she was excited.
Yu Jiyou hurriedly came to help. "Did you fall somewhere? "
"Knees..."
As soon as he heard this, he immediately helped her onto the sedan chair, lifted up the hem of her skirt and checked, and saw a large red mark on her round and tender knee.
"Will it hurt? ” He gently kneaded her knees.
"It hurts..."
"Is that so? "He tried to move her calf, just because he was afraid that she would hurt her bones.
It didn't hurt as much as before - she was about to answer, but when she saw the worry on his face, she suddenly forgot what she wanted to say. Looking at his appearance, he seemed to really care about her...
Unable to wait for an answer, he raised his head and asked again: "How is it? Does it hurt? "
“…It won’t hurt if you don’t press it. "When she met his inquiring eyes, she panicked and her face suddenly turned red.
He breathed a sigh of relief. “It looks like I just injured my knee, and I’ll be fine if I rest for a couple of days. "
Seeing his gentle and caring manner, she couldn't help but ask again: "You haven't answered me yet, why did you come and help me pick so many flowers? "
"Xiaoguan just said that I don't want to see the princess get hurt. He paused and then said: "The lower official asked the cook to make the princess's favorite 'Sophora Flower Wheat Rice'. I just asked the female officials to serve it. It should be here soon." "
She felt sweet in her heart, but then she thought, no, how did he know that she likes to eat sophora flower wheat rice? "Who told you? "
He looked helpless. "You have so many questions..." Just as he was about to finish his sentence, he heard the sound of footsteps.
"Master Yu, the younger one has brought the things. "
"You eat first. He glanced at her, and then shouted loudly: "Bring it in, the princess is already awake." "
Seeing that he was about to leave after speaking, she hurriedly asked: "Where are you going? "
He sighed. "According to the etiquette, the princess and the subordinate cannot meet in private before worshiping in the hall. "
Here we go again. Puning pouted.
Seeing her expressions of joy and anger, he suddenly felt cute. Only now did he realize that this charming princess was not as difficult to get along with as he had thought before.
“Don’t look at me like that! " She scolded, but her disappointed expression revealed her mood.
Regardless of her protest, Yu Jiyou stretched out his hand in front of her and stroked her cheek like a cat.
"I hate it, who allowed you to touch me..."
This time, he was not scared away by her expression.
“I’ll try to find time to see you. "As soon as I took my hand back, the female officials walked into the red curtains.
"Princess, Master Yu. "
Yu Jiyou nodded. "You serve the princess, I'll leave first. "
"Hey..." Before Puning could finish speaking, Yu Jiyou had already disappeared outside the curtain. "Why are you running in such a hurry? You won't die if you stay with me longer..." She complained, but when she saw the scattered locust petals, she immediately smiled.
Let's just say, how could anyone not like her...
She picked up the feathery petals and threw them into the air. The fragrant flowers scattered and covered her head and body like snow.
Her mood at the moment was as light and cheerful as the flying petals.
Then she looked at the female officials and smiled sweetly. “Bring it here, don’t you want me to order something? "
When she said this, the female officials brought the food to them with smiles on their faces.
Chapter 2(2)
Another day, the brigade was still on its way to Xiangzhou; early in the morning, Yu Jiyou called Hu Li to come over and say hello.
"Our adult watched the clouds this morning. He thought it might rain tomorrow, so he might not stop at noon today to rest and see if he could rush into the next town later. "
In the sedanPuning, who was killing time while knitting and embroidering, raised his head and asked: "Is this what your adults have told me, nothing else?"
"Reply to the princess, of course." Mengli took off a baggage from the saddle. "Our elder discovered this early in the morning. He said that you might like it, princess."
A female officer came to pick her up
They are sweet apricots as red as clouds and as big as a fist.
She lifted the curtain and asked, "Did he pick it especially for me?"
Hu Lijin replied categorically: "Replying to the princess, it is absolutely true. How dare you make such nonsense?"
